upstream.name: hoytech/quadrable
upstream.architecture: Header-only C++ sparse binary Merkle tree, compact proofs, sync, copy-on-write LMDB-backed store, MemStore, and quadb CLI.

benchmarkDenominator.total: 55 tracked upstream paths; check.cpp has 34 top-level scenarios, 29 equivHeads subcases, 136 verify checks, and 20 verifyThrow checks; `make -r test` passes all 34 upstream scenarios after shallow submodule initialization
benchmarkDenominator.source: Local cloned upstream inventory of check.cpp, Makefile, include/quadrable headers, docs, and shallow-initialized submodules at commit 4f44437dc9b951a91986ad69e2856938387be614.
benchmarkDenominator.runnerStatus: passed 2026-05-22 with `make -r test` after `sudo -n dnf install -y gcc-c++ lmdb-devel libb2-devel libasan` and `git submodule update --init --depth 1 external/hoytech-cpp external/lmdbxx external/docopt.cpp`; plain `make test` now gets past missing tooling but this GNU Make environment selects the built-in C++ rule without the repo include flags, so `-r` was used to disable built-in rules while running the upstream test target
benchmarkDenominator.warning: The upstream C++ runner passes locally, but native PHP parity is still partial. Native PHP tests map upstream-compatible BLAKE2s-256 hashing/key behavior, focused in-memory sparse tree update/get/delete scenarios, iterator lower/upper-bound windows, compact proof encoding/decoding, selected proof import/export, integer proof sizing, range proofs, proof-backed updates on imported partial trees, mergeProof expansion of separately imported proofs, bounded sync proof-fragment transport/import with raw-key diff reconstruction, upstream-shaped scan-time diff callbacks, deterministic small sync-fuzz convergence, and an exact WordPress snapshot root under the upstream digest.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Pure-PHP BLAKE2s-256 hash/key primitives plus in-memory sparse tree get/put/delete, update batching, path-independent roots, getMulti, empty-head restoration, delete bubbling equivalence, raw-key iterator windows, compact proof transport encoding/decoding, selected proof import/export, proof-size checks, raw-key range proofs, proof-backed updates against imported partial trees, mergeProof expansion between separately imported proofs, sync request/response transport, bounded sync proof fragments, witness expansion, raw-key diff reconstruction, scan-time diff callbacks, and deterministic small sync-fuzz convergence.

wordpressScenario: Authenticated local-first state sync for Playground snapshots and content databases; current fixtures/examples map ordered WordPress option/post records through raw integer keys, exact upstream-compatible BLAKE2s snapshot roots, iterator windows, compact authenticated range proofs, proof-backed updates, merged partial proofs, sync diffs that reconstruct changed post/meta snapshots, and scan-time diff callbacks that match final authenticated diffs.
